post.title: That Compliment You Deleted Would Have Made Their Day #shorts
post.description: Who deserves one today? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend who deletes every nice text. Rosa wrote Dev a compliment about his talk, then deleted it: too awkward. In 'Insufficiently Complimentary?: Underestimating the Positive Impact of Compliments Creates a Barrier to Expressing Them' (Psychological Science, 2021), Xuan Zhao and Nicholas Epley had people write and send real compliments to friends and others. The people giving compliments underestimated how positive the receivers would feel and overestimated how awkward and uncomfortable it would be. That mismatch is a barrier: we hold back kind words because we get the math wrong. It doesn't mean every message lands perfectly, but the cringe you picture is usually bigger than the one they feel. #psychology #shorts #kindness #compliments #overthinking
